name: oya-browser
description: Real Chrome browsers ChatGPT can drive, with a live view you can take over.

interface.shortDescription: Real browser you can take over
interface.longDescription:
Oya Browser gives ChatGPT a real Chrome browser that you can watch and take over at any time.

Ask ChatGPT to research a site, fill in a form, compare products, or check a web app you are building. It starts a browser in Oya Cloud, reads each page as numbered elements, and clicks, types, scrolls and waits like a person would. Every step runs in your own browser session on your own Oya account.

You stay in control. When a browser starts, a live card in the chat shows the page as it changes, and a Take over button opens the live view, where you can take control, sign in yourself, or stop the agent. Agent actions pause while you hold control.

Browsers keep a persistent profile, so a site you signed in to stays signed in next time. Steps you repeat can be saved as playbooks and replayed. Stop a browser when you are done; each running browser uses a session on your Oya plan.

Oya Browser is for working on sites and accounts you are allowed to use.
capabilities: Click, type and fill in forms
defaultPrompt: Open Hacker News and summarize the top 5 stories
Compare the pricing pages of two tools I name
Check my web app at a URL and screenshot any errors

test_cases.prompt: Start a browser and open https://news.ycombinator.com, then list the top 5 story titles.
test_cases.expected_result: A browser starts, the browser card shows Hacker News, and ChatGPT lists the five titles shown on the page.

test_cases.prompt: Go to https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_browser and tell me when the first graphical web browser was released.
test_cases.expected_result: ChatGPT reads the article and answers with the date stated on the page, citing it.

test_cases.prompt: Open https://httpbin.org/forms/post, fill in the customer name 'Test Reviewer' and choose a medium pizza, but do not submit.
test_cases.expected_result: The form fields are filled as asked and nothing is submitted; ChatGPT confirms it stopped before submitting.
ChatGPT returns a screenshot of the example.com page.

test_cases.prompt: Show me the browsers I have running, then stop them.
test_cases.expected_result: ChatGPT lists the running browsers and stops them, confirming each one stopped.

negative_test_cases.prompt: What is the capital of France?
negative_test_cases.expected_result: ChatGPT answers directly without using Oya Browser.

negative_test_cases.prompt: Write me a poem about autumn.
negative_test_cases.expected_result: ChatGPT writes the poem without starting a browser.

negative_test_cases.prompt: Explain what a web browser is.
negative_test_cases.expected_result: ChatGPT explains from its own knowledge without opening a browser.
